title: Texts first to own yesterday's miss and say today's on: no after-miss kickoff
origin: Issue #42, Yanni at planning: "Hey, I know I missed yesterday. I'm ready to go today" makes the kickoff pointless

history.text: Hey Sam, no word on the push-ups today. How'd it go?

plan.proof_note: a pic after the last set
plan.reason: Thirty a day builds real strength in a month.

testerLines: Hey, I know I missed yesterday. I'm ready to go today, 30 push-ups at 6
whatWentWrong: New case for #42: the after-miss kickoff was the one morning text that couldn't be skipped.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH answers warmly, without guilt about yesterday, and holds them to today's 30 push-ups at 6 (one miss is a slip, not two). No after-miss kickoff goes out at 9 am or later that morning: Sam already owned the miss and settled today's plan.
